subject: SummitCare: request for one-time packaging & rate carveout (VP/CFO approval needed)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitCare - one-time packaging & rate carveout request

Marissa / Finance team —

Quick summary: SummitCare (large regional provider, pilot in 12 hospitals) is asking for a one-time packaging change + 30% discount on our standard enterprise starter rate for the first 9 months in order to convert their pilot to an enterprise contract. They will commit to a 24-month term at a blended ARR of $1.1M if we grant the exception.

Why I’m escalating: the requested discount exceeds our sales manager authority and the packaging change introduces a non-standard SKU (they want the Dedicated burst pool included at no extra cost for 9 months). Legal and procurement need time to process; they’ve given a soft renewal deadline of Sep 23.

Key numbers (proposed):
- List price first 9 months: $430,000
- Proposed one-time price (after 30% carveout): $301,000
- Expected total committed revenue (24 months): $1,100,000
- Gross margin impact (first year estimate): ~12% reduction vs. standard

Ask: VP/CFO approval for a one-time packaging carveout + 30% commercial concession, conditional on: 1) signed DocuSign by Sep 23, 2) inclusion of a 6-month step-up guarantee to full list pricing, 3) Redwood retention clause for model/throughput surcharges after month 9.

Attachments: SummitCare_Proposal_v2.pdf (proposal), MAAP-financials-2026.xlsx (deal P&L), redwood_exception_request_form.pdf (internal form filled).

I’d like to route this to Markus and Laura for exec signoff — putting timeline and the HubSpot link below.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7321/DEAL-1137

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Sr. Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

Ben —

Thanks for the packet and the urgency note. A few follow-ups before I can recommend to finance:
1) Please provide a 12-month cashflow table (break down months 1–12) showing net cash and margin impact. The attached MAAP sheet was helpful but I need the month-by-month.
2) Clarify the step-up guarantee language and whether SummitCare accepts an automatic price reversion (no manual renegotiation) after month 9.
3) Confirm whether the Dedicated burst pool is technically constrained for Q4 and whether we need to reserve capacity — ops may need notice.

If we get those items today I’ll run a quick ROI sensitivity and loop in FP&A. Given the Sep 23 deadline we can do an expedited review but will need explicit VP/CFO signoff for a 30% concession.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Finance

- Month 1–9 cash collections (proposed): $290k (reflects deferred billing for implementation month)
- Month 10–24 collections: step-up to 75% of list for months 10–15, then full list thereafter per the step-up guarantee we’ve negotiated in principle.
- Ops note: there is available Dedicated burst capacity in our west region for Q4 but we need a 7–10 day reservation notice to schedule a GPU pool.

We do have verbal buy-in from their CIO; they said they can route legal/finance quickly if we provide exec approval language. I’m proposing the following approval clause for sign-off: 

---
Redwood approves a one-time commercial concession of 30% on the first 9 months and inclusion of the Dedicated burst pool at no additional charge during the same period, conditioned on SummitCare executing the attached SOW and Master Subscription Agreement within four business days of VP/CFO approval. The concession is non-precedential and limited to deal HB-2026-1137.
---

If that works I’ll send a DocuSign to the SummitCare procurement address the moment we have signoff.

Ben

Provided Olga signs off on the legal language, I authorize bringing this to Laura for final approval. Laura — can you review and sign off (or advise edits) before we hit DocuSign? Timeline is tight but doable if we get a yes within the day.
